title: Jubilant Umami Russian Pasta
description: A kid-friendly Russian dish featuring umami flavors, chewy pasta, and white chocolate chips, made with a low-calorie friendly pasta-water-emulsion sauce.

ingredients.name: pasta
ingredients.notes: bow tie or penne work well

instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the pasta according to the package instructions.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat and add the dried thyme, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper.
Add the mushroom broth to the skillet and stir to combine.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer the sauce for 5 minutes.
Stir in the white chocolate chips until melted and smooth.
Combine the cooked pasta and sauce in a large bowl and toss to coat.
Let the pasta cool for a few minutes to allow the sauce to thicken.
Serve the Jubilant Umami Russian Pasta hot and enjoy.
